items.stem: What is the moral of the story, and how does Anand’s character reflect it?
items.answer: The story’s moral is that creativity and imagination, despite potential mistakes, are vital for problem-solving. Anand embodies this. Even when his burglar alarm fails, he persists. His time machine, initially doubted, might have stopped the thief, showcasing his cleverness. Anand’s passion for inventing and resilience after setbacks highlight that creative thinking and perseverance are valuable traits, even if outcomes aren’t perfect. Competency Based Questions

items.stem: What values can be inferred from Anita’s character, especially how she deals with Anand’s inventions?
items.answer: Anita’s character shows patience, responsibility, and a cautious nature. She often warns Anand about his inventions but still gets involved to help. Even when annoyed by his messes, she tries to keep things calm and clean up. She also shows care for him, like noticing his “crestfallen look” when Papa scolds him, highlighting her role as a supportive sister.

The room started humming and strange noises filled the air! I waved my cudgel, but that machine... it hummed louder and everything went blurry. I don’t know where I am now.

items.stem: Anand believed his burglar alarm would work perfectly, but it ended up soaking Papa. What does this incident tell us about the difference between ideas and real-life results in inventions?
items.answer: This incident shows that what an inventor plans in their head doesn’t always work in real life. Anand thought his alarm was “simple” and “planned out carefully.” But it couldn’t tell the difference between a thief and his own father. This highlights that even good ideas need to be thoroughly tested in real situations to see how they truly behave, not just how they are imagined.

items.stem: Anand’s parents were going away and made him promise not to touch the time machine. If you were Anand, what two conflicting thoughts would be going through your mind about that promise after they left?
items.answer: If I were Anand, two conflicting thoughts would be: First, annoyance at not being trusted, thinking, “They don’t believe in my invention! It’s a time machine, not a toy!” Second, an overwhelming urge to test it immediately. I’d think, “It’s all ready! How can I wait? Maybe just a tiny, quick try while they’re gone? No one would know.”

items.stem: At the end, Anand is convinced he is a “genius” and starts a new project about contacting “creatures in outer space.” What qualities does this continued behavior show about Anand’s spirit as an inventor, despite past failures?
items.answer: Anand’s continued behavior shows amazing optimism, strong confidence, and endless creativity. Even though his past inventions failed and others just “smile indulgently,” he truly believes in his genius. He quickly moves to a new, big project, proving he has a persistent and imaginative spirit that never gives up on dreaming of the next great discovery, no matter the setbacks. items.stem: What inspired Anand to build a time machine?
items.answer: Anand was inspired to build a time machine after watching the movie Back to the Future. Captivated by time travel, he transformed his room into a chaotic lab of wires and bulbs. Despite his parents’ attempts to deter him by locking toolboxes and guarding appliances, his unyielding passion for inventing drove him to create this ambitious and complex gadget.

items.stem: How does Anand’s burglar alarm reflect his creative spirit, and what problems does it cause?
items.answer: Anand’s burglar alarm reflects his creative spirit as he invents it from simple materials to deter thieves. His imaginative solution, a water bag drop, showcases his enthusiasm. However, the alarm’s flaw—inability to distinguish family—causes a humorous disaster, drenching his father. This mishap embarrasses the children and frustrates their mother, temporarily halting Anand’s inventing. Despite problems, it highlights his bold creativity and willingness to learn.

items.stem: Why does Anand’s time machine experiment cause tension in the family, and how does it lead to the burglary incident?
items.answer: Anand’s time machine creates tension because his parents fear its impracticality and dangers. His chaotic lab, despite their efforts to stop him, causes friction. This indirectly leads to the burglary; to avoid arguments, parents leave the children home alone. That night, Boppa breaks in. Anand directs him to the time machine room, leading to mysterious noises and Boppa’s disappearance, showcasing the experiment’s unexpected consequences and Anand’s bold creativity.

items.stem: How does Anand’s quick thinking during the burglary show his resourcefulness, and what is the outcome?
items.answer: Anand’s quick thinking during the burglary reveals his resourcefulness. When Boppa breaks in, Anand smartly directs him to his time machine room instead of his father’s, protecting his family. Mysterious sounds follow, and only Boppa’s scarf is found. Anand believes the machine sent Boppa back in time, while adults assume escape. This outcome highlights Anand’s cleverness and resourcefulness, using his invention ingeniously in a crisis.

items.stem: Why is the mystery of Boppa’s disappearance important to the story’s humour and excitement?
items.answer: Boppa’s disappearance adds humour and excitement by blending Anand’s quirky invention with a thrilling twist. The crashes and eerie sounds from the time machine, followed by only Boppa’s scarf remaining, create suspense. The mystery—did he time travel or escape?—fuels humour through Anand’s firm belief against adult skepticism. This unexpected shift from burglary to potential time travel heightens the playful tone, showcasing Anand’s creative spirit and making the story memorable.

items.stem: Explain the mysterious events surrounding the time machine during the burglary.
items.answer: During the burglary, after Anand sends Boppa into his room, mysterious events unfold. Loud crashes, humming, and eerie noises emanate from the time machine’s location. When neighbors investigate, only Boppa’s green scarf remains on the floor; he’s nowhere to be found, yet the machine quietly hums. This leaves his disappearance unexplained: adults believe he fled, while Anand insists the time machine sent him to the past. NODIA
